AI TECHNOLOGY

Data, method, evidence and review.

Water demand changes with the weather and crop stage. Each new forecast requires the model to reassess every active zone and compare the recommendation with available pump capacity.

01 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Zone-level regression

Estimate demand from recent soil, weather, crop-stage and application observations.

How to evaluate it +

Compare a gradient-boosted baseline with the farm’s existing planning method using time-based validation.

02 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Constraint-aware allocation

Compare estimated demand with the available daily water and pump limit.

How to evaluate it +

Check whether the approved allocations fit the stated operating constraints.

03 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Forecast explanation

Prepare a readable explanation of a zone’s next proposed cycle.

How to evaluate it +

Check that the explanation matches the actual forecast inputs and uncertainty.

COMPUTE CHOICE

Start with managed Azure ML batch forecasts. A tabular baseline may use CPU inference; use GPU training only if a more complex time-series model demonstrates a useful improvement. Scale recurring zone forecasts and missing-data monitoring independently.

Architecture and evaluation plan. The candidate sector models require implementation and validation.

Infrastructure for agriculture workloads.

PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Static Web Apps

Serve the product interface through managed HTTPS and a CDN when the Azure deployment is configured. The current public release is hosted on GitHub Pages.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Microsoft Entra ID

Use organization membership and reviewer/operator roles. Production identity and tenant authorization are planned; public sample access is not an Entra account.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Blob Storage

Keep source versions under tenant-scoped access, with encryption and retention rules configured for the actual data. Storage isolation must be implemented and tested.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Key Vault + managed identity

Keep provider credentials on the server. Move deployment secrets into Key Vault and use managed workload identity where supported.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Service Bus + Azure ML

Queue new inputs, cache unchanged evidence and handle failed jobs. Select CPU, managed inference or evaluated GPU serving according to the product’s model path.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Private Link

Use private service endpoints for supported internal data paths when the deployment’s network design requires them. No private network deployment is claimed by this static release.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Monitor, Application Insights + Defender for Cloud

Track processing failures, access events and resource health. Set retention, alert ownership and security posture checks before production use.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

A farm operator checks sensor quality and local conditions before any watering decision. This MVP does not control pumps.

  1. 01

    Read the conditions

    Bring together recent soil readings, crop stage and the next weather period.

  2. 02

    Forecast demand

    Estimate the next day’s water requirement for each zone.

  3. 03

    Check the limits

    Show the effect of a daily water or pump-capacity limit.

  4. 04

    Approve the cycle

    The irrigation manager chooses the plan and records the outcome.

REVIEW WORKSPACE

Evidence-led processing.
An accountable reviewer.

The public review desk includes source-linked prepared cases. The server adapter supports connected analysis with your configured model service.

01

Available in the website

Choose two cases, run the prepared analysis, inspect cited evidence, accept a report for review and download it. The dashboard also supports operational notes, status changes, search, filtering and CSV export.

02

Connected AI analysis

The included Node server calls an AI provider with your text and optional images. It asks for a structured report with source references. Configure the API key on the server; no key is embedded in this public website.

03

Repeated processing

The adapter caches identical input for a limited period. New or changed evidence produces a new analysis. Published workload totals are planning arithmetic, not actual customer traffic.

04

Human judgment

A farm operator checks sensor quality and local conditions before any watering decision. This MVP does not control pumps.

05

Before operating commercially

Connect the real source systems, implement verified accounts and organization access, evaluate the model on representative inputs and define how operators handle uncertain results.
